# Feature: Patroller — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #31 (Patroller) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: loops a fixed path, touch resets you. Unique: a lethal enemy on a predictable loop. Useful: readable timing windows to cross a corridor. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** loops a fixed path, touch resets you.

**So that** readable timing windows to cross a corridor.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Patroller for the first time in its teaching room (mech-31-patroller-room). Teaching moment: First room: a patroller loops across the only corridor on a readable cycle. A player who walks straight across is touched and returned to the room start, which teaches that the loop, rather than the distance, is what has to be timed. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Moves one tile per player move along its marked loop, forever
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: If you step onto it or it steps onto you, you return to the level start (or checkpoint)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Its loop never changes unless a mirror block redirects it

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Its loop never changes unless a mirror block redirects it
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Patroller's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-31-patroller-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #31.
